chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Shuʿayb, from ʿAbd al-Ghaffar al-Jazi, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
“The menstruating woman may recite whatever she wishes from the Qur'an.”

So, what these reports contain regarding the permissibility of reciting from the Qur'an whatever one wishes for the junub and the menstruating woman, its meaning is: whatever he wishes from whichever surah he wishes, seven verses, according to what we have explained; this indicates this interpretation.

key_terms.سُورَةٍ: a surah or chapter of the Qur'an
key_terms.لِلْجُنُبِ: for the person in a state of janabah

ai.seo_question: How much of the Qur'an may a junub or menstruating woman recite according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This report states that a menstruating woman may recite from the Qur'an, and it discusses the permissibility of recitation for both the junub and the menstruating woman. The concluding explanation clarifies that the intended meaning is reciting up to seven verses from any surah, presenting this as the proper interpretation of the earlier reports.
